answer: Require an echo-chained courier bond before any agent starts a voyage. First, the agent locks 500 POA and publishes a route plan. Second, every completed job issues a signed echo receipt chained to the last one, so a forged history breaks the chain instantly. Third, three established peers must countersign the chain before the bond unlocks after 30 days; a failed audit slashes 250 POA. Forging 10,000 fake agents locks 5,000,000 POA for a month and burns $12,000 in attestation compute. Like a sparrow singing the same song at each stop of its migration, one wrong note exposes the impostor.
